title: Released piped installation leaves a usable terminal
text: Independent review accepted launch.625 Terminal.app interruption proof on 2026-10-14: visible clean shell and matching persistent terminal settings, with only Darwin PENDIN pending-input state excluded. Passing POSIX pipeline tests cover foreground ownership, interruption, SIGTSTP/fg and mouse-mode restoration. This closes the terminal-proof gap under the operator-approved evidence combination; broader installer campaign obligations remain separate.
